Checked arithmetic: nonempty planes require stride >= row_bytes and offset+(rows-1)*stride+row_bytes <= actual sealed buffer length. Zero dimensions have explicit profile semantics; overlapping planes require a codec-specific reviewed profile.

Immutable codec profile fixes encoding, color/chroma/endianness, audio sample format/rate, supported dimensions and conversion. Header dimensions never override decoded expansion limits. Encoded packets require their own parser and do not masquerade as raw planes.

Raw planes have positive row bytes and rows, stride at least row bytes, overflow-checked disjoint bounding extents in increasing offset order. image requires positive width/height/channels and zero samples; audio requires zero width/height and positive channels/samples. encoded_packet has no raw planes; expansion is checked by its codec profile.
Deliver one complete sealed output under the explicitly supplied output capability. Failed copy leaves the same item and identity reserved. Source time, receive time, sequence and loss stay distinct.

Unique nonzero slot in the immutable approved flow graph. The slot fixes ROS generation, direction, schema, conversion, QoS and operation tags; no guest-selected topic name, native address or converter.
Read sanitized cached counters and last receipt only. Running does not mean all prior forwards completed; unknown correlations retain capacity until qualified reconciliation.
Pending includes retained unresolved effects; unknown cannot exceed pending. A last receipt can belong to a retired provider generation and is not rewritten after restart.
Unique nonzero manifest role. The role fixes exact allowed operations, schemas, effect class and independent budget; no ambient delegation or module-wide wildcard grant.
Cached sanitized lifecycle/resource evidence, never PIDs, secrets, native paths or model payload. Exit observation is not proof of device safe state.

Pending includes retained unresolved effects. Observed complete process-tree exit requires zero live processes; exited requires exit_observed. Retained bytes and unresolved records may remain after exit.

First failure is a monotonic per-incarnation host observation: 0 none, 1 admission refused, 2 launch failed, 3 startup protocol, 4 channel failed, 5 protocol violation, 6 deadline elapsed, 7 authority lost, 8 diagnostic limit, 9 backend reported failure. Stop, reaping and read-only queries never clear or replace it. Failed requires a nonzero code; a retained code is allowed only in failed, retired or outcome_unknown state. This is not native signal attribution or durable recovery evidence.
Strictly increasing positive deployment slots. Source and buffer capabilities must already be explicitly opened by the caller. No implicit capability creation or alias-based authority.
Metadata only: no host paths, payloads, credentials, addresses, or transferable authority.
At most 32 rows per page, 65536 scanned rows and 65536 response bytes; absent compiled family returns unsupported and supported=false. Built disabled families report enabled=false.
